data.headline: Questions I wanted answered, so I ran the numbers.
data.intro: An ongoing series of original analyses — prediction market calibration, economic modelling, conflict duration, and market base rates. Every post publishes its methodology, its sources, its limitations, and the code, so you can disagree with the conclusion on the evidence rather than on vibes.
principles: The question comes before the dataset. If the answer isn't interesting when it goes the other way, it isn't a good question.
Methodology and sources are published before the results, so the analysis can't drift toward the more publishable conclusion.
Limitations are stated by the author, not discovered by the reader.
Base rates over hot takes. A structural finding is still useful next year; a reaction to this week isn't.
Every analysis is reproducible from the linked code and public data.
